mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_GAEJUNG WHERE SDEL_YN = 'N'
AND UPPER(SNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%'
SELECT IGAEJUNG_NO, SNAME, ISEQ, SDIFF_YN, SDEL_YN, SINS_DT FROM TB_GAEJUNG WHERE SDEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY ISEQ, IGAEJUNG_NO
SELECT IGAEJUNG_NO, SNAME, ISEQ, SDIFF_YN, SDEL_YN, SINS_DT FROM TB_GAEJUNG WHERE IGAEJUNG_NO = #{gaejungNo}
SELECT IGAEJUNG_NO, SNAME, ISEQ, SDIFF_YN, SDEL_YN, SINS_DT FROM TB_GAEJUNG WHERE SNAME = #{gaejungNm}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ISEQ), 0) + 1 FROM TB_GAEJUNG WHERE SDEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GAEJUNG (IGAEJUNG_NO, SNAME, ISEQ, SDIFF_YN, SDEL_YN, SINS_DT) VALUES (#{gaejungNo}, #{gaejungNm}, #{seq}, #{diffYn}, 'N', TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_GAEJUNG SET SDEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE IGAEJUNG_NO = #{gaejungNo}
